examples.arabic: الجار دخل البيت و رجع بسرعة
examples.english: The neighbor entered the house and returned quickly.
examples.transliteration: El gar dakhal el bet wa ragaa bsoraha

examples.arabic: الصبح جار فتح باب بيته وريحة اكل سخن طلعت
examples.english: In the morning, a neighbor opened his house door, and the smell of hot food came out.
examples.transliteration: El sobh gaar fataḥ baab beito w reeḥet akl sokhn tele3et.

examples.arabic: ممكن نسأل الجار يساعدنا بكرة الصبح
examples.english: Maybe we can ask the neighbor to help us tomorrow morning.
examples.transliteration: Momken nes'al el-gar yesa'edna bokra el-sobh.
examples.storyTitle: The Light Bulb Problem at Home

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا جار عامل ايه
examples.english: Good morning neighbor how are you
examples.transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya gar a'amel eh

examples.arabic: الجارة ام احمد بتكلم الجار الجديد احمد
examples.english: The neighbor Um Ahmed is talking to the new neighbor Ahmed.
examples.transliteration: El-gara Om Ahmed betkallem el-gar el-gedid Ahmed.
